thread:
maya_pm: quick question — i'm drafting the roadmap note for model-catalog lifecycle changes. we keep hitting a policy gap: models that pass perf and safety but fail one benchmark (usually hallucination) — do we gate them from GA or let them on a "beta pin" with customer opt-in?
ethan_eng: my take: GA should be reserved for full-check pass. beta pin sounds fine for early access, but it must be explicit in the contract (no SLA on quality). :+1:
maya_pm: agree. customer requests are coming in from jordan_sales — they want earlier access with pinning guarantees. they care about latency and embedding cost, less about edge hallucination right now.
jordan_sales: yup, customer is willing to accept quality caveats if we provide a rollback/fallback plan and labeled prompt sets for their app. also wants telemetry hooks.
li_devex: proposal: add a 3-stage admission path in the catalog metadata: sandbox -> beta-pin -> GA. each stage has a checklist. sandbox = internal-only + smoke; beta-pin = customer opt-in + labeled prompts + fallback policy; GA = all checks + SLA. i sketched a minimal schema:
```
admission_stage: beta-pin
checks:
  - perf: p95_latency_ms < 250
  - embeddings_cosine_stability > 0.88
  - hallucination_suite: fail_count <= 1
  - safety: no high-severity flagged examples
beta_requirements:
  - customer_opt_in: true
  - instrumented_prompts: true
  - fallback_route: compatible_model_id
```
sam_sre: +1 to the three-stage model. add operational constraints: beta pins must advertise burst capacity limits and have a scheduled rollback window in the config. we can't have indefinite pinned beta workloads without capacity planning.
maya_pm: good call. we should also define a maximum beta duration (e.g., 90 days) and a renewal gate. if the model fails to meet GA bar after 2 renewals, automatically move it back to sandbox.
ethan_eng: from engineering: we need clear migration hooks in runtime for pin toggles. suggest an annotation in catalog entry: `migration_policy: canary|immediate|manual` and a `pin_expiry_ts`. runtime will enforce fallback if pin expired.
li_devex: also worth defining the benchmark signal thresholds we surface in the UI. currently 'hallucination_suite' is opaque. suggest we surface per-test pass/fail and a short explanation string. simplifies salesperson conversations.
jordan_sales: that would be huge — we can show a customer a 1-line reason why the model is beta. helps with risk agreements.
catalog-bot: reminder: there is an upcoming model onboarding freeze next Monday for infra migration. any beta pin grants should be submitted before Fri EOD to be reviewed.
maya_pm: action list: 1) li to draft catalog admission_state schema PR (ETA Wed) 2) ethan to spec runtime pin_enforcement API (ETA Thu) 3) sam to write SRE constraints doc and expiry/renewal policy (ETA Fri) 4) jordan to capture customer opt-in language and telemetry requirements (ETA Fri)
ethan_eng: one more engineering note: we need a cheap eval hook that runs per-candidate deployment to avoid regressions. suggest `preflight_checks` job in CICD that runs sample prompts + diff against baseline. can push a very small harness.
li_devex: will include a sample preflight config in the PR. for reference, my suggested default preflight runs 250 prompts, measures hallucination delta, embedding similarity drift, and mean latency.
maya_pm: ok looks like consensus. if no objections i'll turn this into a roadmap ticket and surface the new acceptance path in the next product sync. :rocket:
